content:
ana-partnerships: kickoff for AWS Marketplace IaC kit. Scope: one Terraform module, a small ECS/k8s sample, and a ref-arch diagram for the listing. target: 8 business days. who can own the AWS module?

sam-terraform: I can own module + CI. plan: single-region (us-east-1) with a `enable_private_subnet` flag. will add outputs for alb_dns and iam_role.

leo-arch: I'll do the ref-arch. will include notes for Dedicated GPU pools vs shared hosted, and call out NVidia vs Graviton guidance.

maya-devex: I'll write quickstart and the sample app README. need a tiny deploy script for the demo video. can someone record a clean run?

owen-ml: ops note: recommend `m6g.4xlarge` (Ampere) for quantized models and `p4d` family for fp16-heavy workloads. include a tainted node group example so inference pods land on GPU-only nodes.

legal-bot: reminder: attach dataflow diagram before external partner review; redact any PII paths.

sam-terraform: brief README snippet for consumption:

```terraform
module "redwood_aws_marketplace" {
  source       = "git::https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-iac.git//modules/aws?ref=stable"
  aws_account  = var.aws_account
  region       = var.region
  enable_private_subnet = true
  instance_type = var.instance_type
}
```

maya-devex: I'll mock screenshots and draft listing copy. sam, please drop outputs for `alb_dns` and `consumer_sa`.

ana-partnerships: (typo) sorry meant ana. timeline: module PR by day 4, docs + demo by day 7. partner expects initial draft by day 5. blocker?

sam-terraform: no blockers. opening PR with basic module and CI lint in 48h.

leo-arch: diagram ready in 24h, will post link. tagging @sam-terraform @maya-devex @owen-ml. :white_check_mark:
